name: Zhejiang Huatong Meat Products Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Huatong Meat Products Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in pig farming and slaughtering in China. The company offers fresh pork and poultry, Jinhua ham, processed meat products, feed, and braised products. It is also involved in livestock and poultry breeding, slaughtering, and processing; deep processing of meat products; feed processing; and mechanical, food trade, plantation, and aquaculture activities. Zhejiang Huatong Meat Products Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Yiwu, China.
